description: Boolean status flag stored as string with heterogeneous representations including 'True'/'False', '1'/'0', and 'yes'/'no'. Contains 30 records with 6 distinct values representing binary states, with no missing values. The column is technically stored as string but intended to be boolean.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Unify heterogeneous boolean representations to consistent boolean values: '1' → True, '0' → False, 'yes' → True, 'no' → False, 'True' → True, 'False' → False.
[VALIDATE] Ensure all values conform to the selected boolean format (True/False) after standardization.
